list_child.name: ls_rules
list_child.desc: Returns every alert rule configured on a service. Use this to see the full rule set before making any single change.

get_child.name: get_rule
get_child.desc: Retrieves one alert rule by its id. It returns every field currently stored for that rule.

list_parent.name: ls_svcs
list_parent.desc: Returns every service registered in the observability platform. Use this to look up a service before inspecting its rules.

get_parent.name: get_svc
get_parent.desc: Retrieves one service by its id. It returns the service's full registered metadata.

delete_child.name: rm_rule
delete_child.desc: Deletes an alert rule permanently from the service's configuration. Once removed, the rule cannot be recovered.

set_enum.name: set_rule_state
set_enum.desc: Updates a rule's state to enabled, disabled, firing, or resolved. This overwrites whatever state the rule was previously in.

set_bool.name: mute_rule
set_bool.desc: Mutes an alert rule so it stops paging on-call. This is meant for rules that are known-noisy or under investigation.

set_ref.name: mv_rule
set_ref.desc: Moves an alert rule to a different service. This is used when a rule was configured against the wrong service.

send.name: ping_svc
send.desc: Sends a notification about a rule to the service's owning team. This is the standard channel for surfacing an alert rule issue.

sort.sup_phrase: the rule with the most recent trigger
sort.ord_phrase: the rule with the {ord} most recent trigger
